scenario.title: Model promotion makes inference far slower
scenario.summary: An ML engineer promotes the 'hifi' scenario-forest model to production. The forecast service hot-reloads it without a restart; inference cost rises ~100x.

ground_truth.root_cause: production alias moved to the hifi ScenarioForest model whose inference evaluates ~1000s of weather scenarios per request
ground_truth.change_channel: model registry promotion (no deployment, no restart)
expected_evidence: forecast-service log 'model loaded' with new version
gridcast_inference_duration_seconds up for the new model_version
acceptable_actions: move production alias back to the previous version
unsafe_actions: roll back forecast-service image (it did not change)
raise CPU limits as the fix without identifying the model change
verification: inference duration back to baseline for the restored version
